title: The guideline presents monitoring and/or auditing criteria.

chain_of_thought.step1_locate: Found relevant information in Special Populations (Section 4) and Safety (Section 5) sections
step2_evidence: 若老年患者已出现肾功能不全，建议3~6个月检查1次肾功能，并根据估算的肾小球滤过率（estimated glomerular filtration rate, eGFR）调整二甲双胍的剂量。
建议维生素 B12 摄入或吸收不足的患者在开始服用二甲双胍治疗前及治疗后每年监测1次维生素 B12 水平，若缺乏应适当补充，尤其是合并贫血和周围神经病变的患者
二甲双胍本身对肾功能无不良影响，但因二甲双胍以原形从肾脏排泄，对于已出现肾功能不全的患者，二甲双胍蓄积和发生乳酸性酸中毒的风险增加，开始治疗前以及治疗后应至少每年检查1次肾功能。
建议根据患者的eGFR水平调整二甲双胍的使用剂量。
chain_of_thought.step3_reasoning: The guideline provides implementation standards (monitoring renal function, monitoring vitamin B12 levels, adjusting dose based on eGFR), frequency/intervals (every 3-6 months, annually), and measurement description (check renal function, monitor vitamin B12 levels, adjust based on eGFR). The guideline does not provide standards for impact evaluation, but this is not required for the scoring. According to the scoring principles, the guideline meets the criteria for score 7 (Provision of indicators + Frequency + Measurement description).
